text:
jess.design: Dropping the prototype for a compact onboarding card that sits in the hero and expands into a micro-runbook. Need quick feedback on microcopy, keyboard flow, and test coverage.

rajesh.product: Nice. Quick product note: samples should be optional. Make the primary action "Start a project" and secondary "Play a demo". We want to nudge conversion but not block.

phil.eng: Implementation constraints: the expand animation mustn't delay core render. I'll make it CSS-only with reduced-motion fallback. Persist dismiss in user prefs for logged-in users; localStorage for guests.

ada.a11y: A11y checklist: 
- Card must be reachable via tab in the page navigation order.
- Expanded micro-runbook should be a region with `aria-labelledby` and focus moves into it.
- Announce expansion: use aria-live polite when content loads asynchronously.
- Buttons should have accessible names: avoid short verbs like "Go" or "Try". Use "Launch demo" or "Create API key".

jess.design: Copy draft: 
Headline: "Get a demo running"
Subhead: "Sample projects to explore Redwood features in minutes"
Primary CTA: "Start a project"
Secondary CTA: "Launch Chat demo"
Microhint: "No code required"

rajesh.product: Headline ok. Suggest primary CTA be more specific: "Create your first project" 14
Also we should show estimated time per sample e.g., "~2 min" on the card.

phil.eng: Will add ETA badges. For analytics we need `onboard.card_impression`, `onboard.card_expand`, `onboard.action_create_project`, `onboard.action_launch_sample`. Include variant id.

ada.a11y: Two more nits: 
1) Ensure contrast for the microhint text meets AA when body text size is 12px.
2) If a user collapses the card with ESC, return focus to the original CTA and announce "Samples collapsed".

jess.design: Good catches. I'll tweak copy: Primary = "Create your first project", Secondary = "Launch Chat demo (2 min)". Add visible ETA chip.

rajesh.product: Rollout plan: 5% new orgs for 3 days, measure launch rate and time-to-first-success. If > 25% lift, widen rollout.

phil.eng: Dev plan: 1 frontend day to wire UI + focus rules, 1 backend day for persistence + events. Will include reduced-motion handling.

ada.a11y: I'll write a short acceptance checklist for keyboard/VoiceOver/NVDA runs and post it to the ticket.

qa-bot: Preview build queued: staging-1982. Will run baseline smoke and a11y regression.

jess.design: Thanks everyone — I'll push the updated mock and add the acceptance criteria to the ticket. :sparkles:
